name: Patchwork Skirmish
description: A turn-based tactical quilt where each patch's health is the visible area it occupies.
natural_language: Keep your colored patches alive and remove every rival patch. Select a patch, move or strike, then end the turn to read the response. Plan around the fact that a patch's health is its visible occupied area: every strike removes a cell from the footprint. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.notes: Original seeded quilt transformation of the cited Status Code space-as-health tactic. The browser and exported verifier replay the same connected footprint translations, edge-cell attacks, and deterministic rival response.
